chunks: They are the ones who say: "Do not spend on those who are with the Apostle of God till they break away (from him)." To God belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites do not understand.
ai.seo_question: What did the hypocrites say about spending on the companions of the Prophet?
ai.summary: In the context of the Expedition of Tabuk, this verse critiques the hypocrites who urged withholding wealth from the Prophet to force his companions' dispersal, reflecting their stinginess and political maneuvering. Shia scholarship highlights this as a manifestation of their spiritual blindness, contrasting their limited view with the divine reality that all treasures belong to Allah, thereby underscoring their lack of true understanding (fahm).
